title: Testing Interchangeability in LLM Agent Teams
abstract: arXiv:2609.05279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production multi-agent systems replace agents constantly, on the assumption that an agent filling a role is interchangeable with any other agent that can do the job. We test that assumption. Eight teams per setting are formed independently from one base model on the same tasks, each agent keeping a private notebook across ten formation episodes; we then trade role-matched agents between teams and measure what changes on held-out tasks. Against a placebo that reproduces the disruption of a roster change without changing who occupies the seat, a swap costs little in task score but raises the communication a team spends per unit of progress by 16 to 63 percent, and in Hanabi a swapped agent is more expensive than an inexperienced one, consistent with interference from conventions learned with its former partner. translated_title: 测试LLM智能体团队中的可互换性
translated_abstract: 生产级多智能体系统经常更换智能体，其前提假设是：担任某一角色的智能体可以与任何其他能够胜任该工作的智能体互换。我们对这一假设进行了检验。在每种设置下，从同一个基础模型独立组建八个团队执行相同任务，每个智能体在十轮形成阶段中保留私人笔记本；随后我们在团队之间交换角色匹配的智能体，并测量在保留任务上发生了什么变化。与一个重现人员变动干扰但不改变实际担任者的安慰剂对照相比，更换智能体在任务得分上损失很小，但会使团队每单位进度所花费的通信量增加16%到63%；在Hanabi中，被换入的智能体比缺乏经验的智能体成本更高，这与它与原伙伴学到的协作惯例产生干扰的假设相符。在Collab-Overcooked中，当设定议程的智能体被更换时，大部分额外的通信来自……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过在独立形成的LLM智能体团队之间交换角色匹配的智能体，发现人员替换几乎不影响任务得分，却使团队每单位进度的通信开销增加16%–63%，且被换入的智能体有时比新手成本更高，表明智能体因携带与原伙伴形成的协作惯例而并非可互换。
en_tdlr: By trading role-matched agents between independently formed LLM agent teams, this study shows that swaps barely affect task scores but raise communication cost per unit of progress by 16–63%, and swapped agents can cost more than inexperienced ones, revealing that agents are not interchangeable due to conventions learned with former partners.
